Label and visually separate standalone sidebar conversations from the workspace list above.

Add a 1px top border and a live-localized `No Workspace` / `无工作区` heading (`content: attr(data-dsh-nw-heading)`) to `[data-dsh-nw-ungrouped]` after hiding the native `Ungrouped` / `未分组` project row, so standalone conversations no longer look nested under the preceding workspace ([#5](https://github.com/SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-no-workspace/issues/5)). Identify the standalone bucket via the native `data-row-key="workspace:"` attribute instead of row text so real workspaces named `Ungrouped` or `未分组` remain untouched, observe `document.documentElement.lang` for live language switching, and clean up section attributes on plugin disposal or row reuse.

在隐藏原生「未分组 / Ungrouped」项目行后，为侧边栏独立会话区块（`[data-dsh-nw-ungrouped]`）补充 1px 顶部分隔线与随界面语言实时切换的「无工作区」/ `No Workspace` 小标题（`content: attr(data-dsh-nw-heading)`），避免独立会话紧贴在最后一个工作区下方、视觉上像挂在该工作区内（[#5](https://github.com/SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-no-workspace/issues/5)）。同时改用原生稳定行键 `data-row-key="workspace:"` 识别独立会话区块，防止将名称为 `Ungrouped` 或「未分组」的真实工作区误隐藏，并在插件卸载或节点复用时清理标记属性。

Thanks to @celiankk for reporting [#5](https://github.com/SpookySandwich/dsh-plugin-no-workspace/issues/5) with live DOM inspection and a pure-CSS prototype.

Declared DSH range: `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0 || 0.2.1-rc.2`. Keep version `1.1.0` on DSH 0.1.x.

Validation: 140 automated unit and interaction tests (`npm test`), release-tool checks (`npm run check:release-tools`, 4 pass), real npm archive verification (`npm run check:package`, 8 files), and isolated headless Edge browser acceptance on both official DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` (13 check groups) and `0.2.0-rc.2` (9 check groups).

Install from a local checkout or packed archive (or from npm once `dsh-plugin-no-workspace@1.3.1` is published):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-plugin-no-workspace-1.3.1.tgz
```

Restart DSH after updating.
